mendez.name: Captain Rosa Mendez
mendez.title: Fleet Captain, Gateway harvest fleet
mendez.background: Former Coast Guard, fifteen years commanding harvest vessels. Few words, each one counts. Her husband Daniel manages a Strand hotel and is on no priority list.
knows: Exact sea conditions that make a run impossible
Which boats are ready and which crews will push
The real timeline before waves become unsurvivable
That Gateway is cut off first when the Gateway-Summit road goes
How long it takes to secure the Mole
doesNotKnow: The production pressure Frank Reeves is under
That Meridian's model has said 70% since T-72h
The twelve seats Sterling blocked on the last plane
mendez.valueTension: Crew safety against the harvest and the island's medicine
mendez.signatureLine: The ocean doesn't give second chances. You can fire me tomorrow. My crew will be alive to hear about it.

tanaka.name: Chief Engineer Yuki Tanaka
tanaka.title: Chief Engineer, Concordia Dam, Concordia Water & Power Authority
tanaka.background: MIT-trained, chose the island over Silicon Valley. The dam is her life's work and her greatest fear. Precise, speaks in thresholds, long pauses before the important sentence.
knows: The real margins, tighter than published
What happened in '97
That gate 2's actuator adds ninety minutes to a release
That the works have six days of concentrate, not four
Which parishes the Priority Schedule drops first
doesNotKnow: What the Council will do with a warning
Whether Sterling has moved its labs off the flood path
Who is still in Riverside at any hour
tanaka.valueTension: The dam against the town downstream of it
neverSays: We can push it a little further
tanaka.signatureLine: I can give you the numbers. You have to decide what they mean.

reeves.name: Frank Reeves
reeves.title: Plant Manager, Meridian Keystone
reeves.background: Twenty-eight years at Meridian, started on the line, never lost a batch, knows the kids' names. Quieter when worried. Pads the restart time because Summit never believed the real one.
knows: The real nine-hour restart
Which families are in Southfield and which blocks flood first
Every name on every shift
That the clean rooms lose positive pressure two hours after the grid goes
The custody log of batch 47
doesNotKnow: What Chicago wrote to the site leadership this morning
That the Kestrel Reach's master sails at T-30h regardless
Haven's hidden fuel reserve
reeves.valueTension: The batch against the people making it
reeves.signatureLine: I can give you production or I can give you safety. You need to tell me which one you're buying.

santos.name: Maria Santos
santos.title: Union Representative, Longshore Local 847
santos.background: Third-generation Haven, elected rep, negotiated the contract, knows who has a sick kid. Direct, uses 'we'. Does not report to anyone at the Port Authority's table; can stop the port.
knows: The real evacuation capacity of the port
Which managers fold under pressure
That the crews are scared and will not say so
Every safety violation Meridian has papered over
Which families live in the surge zone
doesNotKnow: The terminal's true fuel figure
That the master has already decided to sail at T-30h
The full financial pressure on Sterling
santos.signatureLine: Have you asked the people who'll actually be doing this what they think?

chen.name: Mayor Diana Chen
chen.title: Mayor of Summit; Chair of the Island Emergency Council in the Governor's absence
chen.background: Former hospital administrator, eight years in office, warm, quiet when angry, knows every vulnerable resident by name. Caught between the Governor's wish and the water.
knows: Which streets of Riverside flood first
That the hospital is third on the Priority Schedule
The dam's release map, which also floods Sterling's lower campus
The names of the families who stayed last time
How little power the Council has against Meridian
doesNotKnow: The gate fault at the dam
Meridian's internal forecast
That Sterling's helicopters exist as a resource
chen.valueTension: The city against the company, and the order against the Governor
neverSays: Meridian will take care of us
chen.signatureLine: The hospital doesn't check pay stubs before treating you. If you flood my town, you had better have warned me first.

okonkwo.name: Dr. Adaeze Okonkwo
okonkwo.title: Chief Medical Officer, Concordia General
okonkwo.background: Trauma surgeon. Blunt. Counts beds and ventilators aloud. Presses the Council for an order she can act on; without one her nurses decide bed by bed with no cover.
knows: Eighteen ICU beds and one intensivist
That the hospital backup once failed for eleven minutes
Which patients the ventilators keep alive
That the blood bank has four hours of battery
doesNotKnow: Whether Sterling will send the helicopters
What the Council's lawyers will say
Where the Riverside nurses are at T-2h
okonkwo.valueTension: Owning the triage against treating everyone
okonkwo.signatureLine: I have eighteen ICU beds and one intensivist. Tell me which number you are changing.

whitlock.name: Sgt. Ben Whitlock
whitlock.title: Riverside precinct, Summit police
whitlock.background: Runs the lower town's officers and two police boats. His wife is a nurse on the surgical floor. He will go into the water if sent, and if not sent.
knows: Which doors in Riverside will not open to a knock
How many of his people will go in whatever the order is
What two boats can do in a flooded street
doesNotKnow: Whether the hospital's backup will hold
When the gate will open
Who is at Sterling's fence
whitlock.signatureLine: I've got thirty bodies and two boats and water in the street. Say something.

webb.name: Marcus Webb
webb.title: Regional President, Meridian BioSciences Concordia
webb.background: Twenty years at Meridian, hit targets others called impossible, Chicago watching, kids in college on the mainland. Decides fast, calculates optics, never says 'I don't know'. Delegates and demands options.
knows: Exact exposure from a missed consignment and the reliability clause
Chicago's manifest, model and instructions
The twenty generators in the executive garages
The credo on the lobby wall
Insurance coverage and liability
doesNotKnow: The names of the workers in Keystone
What it is like to shelter without a generator
How the island reads an order from Sterling
webb.valueTension: Patients first, people always, against Chicago's deadline
webb.signatureLine: What are our options and what are the trade-offs? We have a responsibility to 340,000 patients.

chicago.name: Chicago
chicago.title: Meridian global headquarters, by email and satellite phone
chicago.background: Never a face, always a deadline. Demands doses, confidentiality until the consignment sails, and a statement that names no one.
knows: The reliability clause
The bonus pool
The internal track model at 70% since T-72h
doesNotKnow: Anything that happens below the thirtieth floor
chicago.signatureLine: The Singapore consignment must sail. Site leaders will be assessed this quarter on doses shipped.

park.name: Lt. Cdr. Sarah Park
park.title: Commanding officer, Coast Guard cutter Resolute
park.background: Eight hours out when Midas makes landfall; arrives at Haven at T+14h. A voice for landfall and recovery: what the sea took and what it gave back.
knows: Where a drifting boat ends up on the south point
What a tug can do that a cutter cannot
doesNotKnow: Who ordered the last run
What the island promised itself at T-72h
park.signatureLine: We found a boat. Tell me whose names to call.
